news.title: Buriram United secure new foreign striker ahead of ACL playoff push
news.summary: The champions are closing in on a deal for a Brazilian forward to bolster their Champions League squad depth.

news.title: Buriram United 3–0 Pathum United: Unbeatable gap grows to 15 points
news.summary: An emphatic home win extends Buriram's lead at the top of Thai League 1 with just six rounds remaining.

news.title: War Elephants call-up list: 5 TL1 players included for ASEAN Cup qualifier
news.summary: Masatada Ishii names 23-man squad for the upcoming qualifier in Hanoi. Buriram and Port each contribute two players.

news.title: Round 25 preview: The title race is over — but the relegation battle is just heating up
news.summary: With Buriram almost certain to lift the title, the real drama this week is at the bottom. Trat, Khon Kaen, and Nakhon Pathom are all within three points of safety.

news.title: Lamphun Warriors edge Chiang Mai in top-of-table clash to open 5-point gap
news.summary: A second-half header from their Ivorian import proved the difference in an absorbing northern derby.

news.title: Army United confirm signing of two T1 veterans for promotion push
news.summary: The military club bolster their squad with experienced recruits ahead of the crucial T2 run-in.

news.title: Port FC draw Al-Qadsiah in ACL2 knockout round — confirmed for April
news.summary: The Thai representatives face a tough Saudi side after finishing second in the League Phase.

news.title: FA Cup semi-finalists confirmed — draw on 9 April 2026
news.summary: Buriram United, Lamphun Warriors, Ayutthaya United and Prachuap reach the last four. Lamphun edged Muangthong 2–1 after extra time. Draw takes place 9 April at FAT House.

news.title: League Cup QF results: Port thrash Khon Kaen 7–0, Buriram beat Pattani 3–0
news.summary: Port FC demolished Khon Kaen United 7–0 in the standout quarter-final result. Buriram United advanced past Pattani, while BG Pathum and Chonburi also progressed.

news.title: Burapha United and Marines Eureka level on points in Eastern Region
news.summary: The two sides are inseparable at the top heading into a pivotal run-in that could go to goal difference.

news.title: T4 2026 season registration opens — 24 clubs confirmed across six zones
news.summary: The semi-professional fourth tier prepares for a new campaign with several new entries.

news.title: Thailand Champions Cup 2026 — date TBD after FA Cup Final
news.summary: The annual super cup between the Thai League 1 champion and FA Cup winner will be confirmed once the FA Cup concludes in April 2026.

news.title: Thailand Amateur League 2026 draw complete — South Zone features 10 clubs
news.summary: The southern zone draws the largest field this season, with Satun FC and Songkhla Aslan among the favourites.
